R. Q. 1 دَمْدَمَ , [inf. n. دَمْدَمَةٌ,] He smeared, or did over, a thing much, or exceedingly, or with energy: and he so covered over a thing. (Ham p. 461. [But the context there indicates that the verb in these two senses should be correctly written دمّم.]) ―
-b2- See also 1, near the middle of the paragraph, and in five places after that.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
